_comment: Territories and states that appear as trading partners or facility locations in the raw
sources but are absent from the World Bank country list, which is where every other
centroid comes from. Coordinates are hand-picked representative points (the capital or
main settlement), consistent with the World Bank's own capital-city coordinates. They are
not computed polygon centroids. Four entries, added only because a real source row
referenced them; nothing here is speculative.
